flow: Susceptible Homosexual Men->Infected Untreated Homosexual Men
Infected Untreated Homosexual Men->Treated with ART
Susceptible Heterosexual Men->Infected Untreated Heterosexual Men
Susceptible Heterosexual Men->Infected Untreated Heterosexual Men
Infected Untreated Heterosexual Men->Treated with ART
Treated with ART->AIDS People living with AIDS
param: C Constant recruitment into susceptible classes (total recruitment)
h Proportion of men in recruitment
c Proportion of men who are heterosexual (so 1-c are homosexual men)
p Proportion of initially treated individuals (initial ART coverage fraction)
λ Natural mortality rate (all compartments)
δ AIDS-induced mortality rate (people living with AIDS)
d AIDS development rate in treated individuals due to ART resistance/treatment failure (T → A)
a Departure rate from untreated infected compartments into treatment (I → T), also described as most sensitive parameter
b_s Probability of sexual transmission in heterosexual contact (men-women)
b_h Probability of sexual transmission in homosexual men contact (homosexual men-homosexual men)
b_hw Probability of sexual transmission from infected homosexual men to women (homosexual men-women contact)
b_hm Probability of sexual transmission from infected homosexual men to heterosexual men (bisexual contact: homosexual men-heterosexual men)
c_s Rate of number of sexual partners in heterosexual contact
c_h Rate of number of sexual partners in homosexual men contact
c_hw Rate of number of sexual partners in contact between homosexual men and women
c_hm Rate of number of sexual partners in contact between homosexual men and heterosexual men
C_h Recruitment into susceptible homosexual men
C_w Recruitment into susceptible women
C_m Recruitment into susceptible heterosexual men
B_h Effective homosexual-men contact transmission factor (b_h * c_h)
B_s Effective heterosexual contact transmission factor (b_s * c_s)
B_hw Effective transmission factor from homosexual men to women (b_hw * c_hw)
B_hm Effective transmission factor from homosexual men to heterosexual men (b_hm * c_hm)
